title: Protected File Mutation Profile v1
description: Smallest closed effect surface for the Glass-Box Governor prototype: mutation of two declared files through one in-process reference monitor.
delegation: NOT_IMPLEMENTED (capabilities with a parent_capability_id are rejected)
declared_residuals: Any filesystem location other than the two declared resources
OS-level channels not enclosed by this profile (subprocess, shell, IPC, plugins, schedulers)
Same-uid processes that can write the files directly (no privilege separation in v0.1)
Semantic judgments about content (the monitor is purely mechanical)
Compromise of the host, interpreter, standard library or the signing key
Effects not represented in this profile's effect set
